Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents

+ + + + + + +

   

+ +
+ +

+ +

+ +## News + +- **[2026-11]** Released our [project page](https://3dcodefactory.github.io/), [technical report](assets/paper/3DCodeFactory.pdf), [3DCodeFactory-Data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/wangzhaoyu/3DCodeFactory), and the `code3d` synthesis & verification framework. + +## Highlights + +### 3DCodeFactory-Data: 10 Domains & 56 Categories + +

+ +

+ +

+ +

+ +[**3DCodeFactory-Data**](https://huggingface.co/datasets/wangzhaoyu/3DCodeFactory) spans **10 primary domains and 56 fine-grained categories** (**87.7%** cross-domain composite scenes), providing **5,045** verified multi-turn trajectories (**2,920 Blender** & **2,125 Three.js**, **5.52B tokens**, median **4,270 LOC** and **413.6 tool calls** per trajectory). Under the default paper profile (`synthesis.blender_static_only = true`), the **Blender** track focuses on high-fidelity offline static modeling and Cycles rendering ($F = \varnothing$), while the **Three.js** track targets browser-native, user-triggered runtime interactivity ($0 \le K \le 3$ verified via Playwright); setting `blender_static_only = false` enables dynamic Blender function synthesis and verification. + +### Results + +**Fine-tuning on 3DCodeFactory-Data substantially boosts downstream 3D generation and editing.** Across **BlenderWorld**, **P3D-Bench**, **3DCodeBench**, and **BlenderGym**, **Qwen3.5-9B** gains **+27.81** average points (**+50.75** on BlenderWorld), and **Qwen3.8-27B** (**66.78** avg.) surpasses the 2.4T flagship **Qwen3.8-Max** (**62.75** avg.): + +| Model | BlenderWorld (Scene ↑) | P3D-Bench (Three.js ↑) | 3DCodeBench (Object ↑) | **Average (↑)** | BlenderGym Editing (PL ↓ / N-CLIP ↓) | +| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | +| GPT-6 Astra | 79.97 | 62.77 | 76.49 | 73.08 | — | +| Claude Opus 5 | 73.04 | 63.31 | 74.12 | 70.16 | — | +| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | 76.08 | 60.48 | 73.80 | 70.12 | — | +| Qwen3.8-Max (2.4T) | 60.58 | 55.79 | 71.89 | 62.75 | — | +| Qwen3.5-9B | 7.16 | 31.93 | 46.40 | 28.50 | — | +|   + 3DCodeVerse (2.03M) | 14.34 | 37.04 | 52.07 | 34.48 | — | +|   **+ 3DCodeFactory (Ours)** | **57.91** *(+50.75)* | **43.22** *(+11.29)* | **67.80** *(+21.40)* | **56.31** *(+27.81)* | — | +| Qwen3.8-27B | 53.02 | 51.63 | 71.32 | 58.66 | 3.544 / 10.617 | +|   + 3DCodeVerse (2.03M) | 53.58 | 51.00 | 71.76 | 58.78 | — | +|   **+ 3DCodeFactory (Ours)** | **70.13** *(+17.11)* | **57.56** *(+5.93)* | **72.65** *(+1.33)* | **66.78** *(+8.12)* | **2.202** *(-37.9%)* / **7.555** *(-28.8%)* | + +

+ +

+  "id": "paper_hall",
+  "backend": "threejs",
+  "reference": "reference.jpg",
+  "requirements": {
+    "title": "Baroque Hall of Mirrors",
+    "context_C": {
+      "application_scenario": "For architectural heritage restoration and digital-twin inspection, use reference image $I$ as a visual anchor to build an offline-executable interactive 3D Baroque Hall of Mirrors scene in Three.js, delivering a self-contained index.html, modular JavaScript source code, local PBR texture assets, README.md, and the main camera render final.png ($1536 x  1024$).",
+      "target_environment": "threejs",
+      "requirement_style": "professional",
+      "reference_mode": "faithful_reconstruction",
+      "deliverables": [
+        "index.html",
+        "source_scripts",
+        "README.md",
+        "final.png"
+      ]
+    },
+    "specification_S": {
+      "core_subjects_and_parts": "(i) Spatial Scale & Bay Layout: Construct the gallery within an $18.0 x  8.2 x  7.8\\,m$ one-point perspective longitudinal volume divided into 5 standard bays topped by a painted barrel-vaulted ceiling, terminating in a semicircular archway, end window, and classical statue; (ii) Core Architectural Elements & Furnishings: Suspend 6 multi-tiered crystal chandeliers along the central axis and arrange 12 symmetrical Corinthian fluted marble pilasters (with gilded capitals and dentil cornices) along both side walls; place tall arched French windows with floor-length sheer white curtains along the left wall, paired with arched gilded mirror niches, carved console tables, blue-and-white porcelain vases, and a right-wall marble fireplace with candelabrum sconces; (iii) Materials & 3D Mesh Instantiation: Differentiate high-reflectance gilded moldings ($metalness=1.0,\\; roughness=0.18$), polished parquet/inlaid marble flooring, sheer curtains, and painted vault frescoes; chandelier crystal strands, capitals, console tables, and vases must be constructed as independent true 3D meshes rather than 2D textures or billboards.",

+# Adapter Protocol v1
+
+Adapter commands are configured as fixed `argv` arrays in `runtime.commands`. For each stage invocation, the workflow appends `--job ABSOLUTE_JSON_PATH`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "schema_version": 1,
+  "stage": "sample",
+  "input": {},
+  "settings": {"models": {}, "runtime": {}},
+  "output_dir": "/run/operations/attempt-01-sample",
+  "result_file": "/run/operations/attempt-01-sample/adapter-result.json"
+}
+```
+
+Write `result_file` only after the stage finishes and all referenced output files are flushed inside `output_dir`.
+
+## Sampling (`sample`)
+
+`input` contains `task_prompt`, `reference` (image path), and `backend` (`blender` or `threejs`). Expected `result_file`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "artifact": "/run/operations/attempt-01-sample/artifact",
+  "trajectory": "/run/operations/attempt-01-sample/trajectory.json",
+  "model": "model-name",
+  "harness": "harness-name"
+}
+```
+
+## Evidence Collection (`collect`) and Verification (`verify`)
+
+`collect` and `verify` receive `artifact`, `reference`, `backend`, and `package` (`requirements` and `rubrics`).
+- `collect` executes `P09`, rendering `reference`, `overall`, `local`, and `task` view sets and recording `display_stability` (`tier` 1..5 and `evidence_files`).
+- `verify` executes `P11`, returning `specification_results`, `functional_results`, and `original_files_modified: false` without mutating the submitted artifact.
+
+## Decontamination (`decontaminate`)
+
+`decontaminate` compares candidate text and reference images against `BlenderWorld`, `P3D-Bench`, `3DCodeBench`, and `BlenderGym`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "complete": true,
+  "passed": true,
+  "benchmarks": ["BlenderWorld", "P3D-Bench", "3DCodeBench", "BlenderGym"],
+  "method": "cosine-similarity-guard",
+  "evidence_files": ["similarity-report.json"]
+}
+```
+
+`scripts/vector_guard.py` implements cosine nearest-neighbor screening given an embedding index and vectorizer command:
+
+```toml
+decontaminate = ["python3", "scripts/vector_guard.py", "--config", "guard.json"]
+```

Setting `synthesis.blender_static_only = false` enables dynamic Blender function synthesis and verification under the unified `P04`/`P11` protocol.

+"""Frozen text/image embedding index guard. No model-specific similarity guesswork.
+
+--config points to JSON containing index, vectorizer argv and calibrated thresholds.
+Vectorizer reads --job and writes text_vector/image_vector + protocol to result_file.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+BENCHMARKS = {"BlenderWorld", "P3D-Bench", "3DCodeBench", "BlenderGym"}
+
+
+def read(p):
+    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
+
+
+def write(p, value):
+    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+
+def cosine(a, b):
+    if not a or len(a) != len(b) or any(not math.isfinite(x) for x in [*a, *b]):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid embedding dimensions/values")
+    na = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a))
+    nb = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in b))
+    if not na or not nb:
+        raise ValueError("Zero embedding vector")
+    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b)) / (na * nb)
+
+
+def evaluate(index, candidate, text_threshold, image_threshold):
+    if not -1 <= text_threshold <= 1 or not -1 <= image_threshold <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("Thresholds must be calibrated cosine values in [-1,1]")
+    if index["protocol"] != candidate["protocol"]:
+        raise ValueError("Embedding protocol/model/revision mismatch")
+    if not BENCHMARKS <= index["groups"].keys() or "fewshots" not in index["groups"]:
+        raise ValueError("Index must include four frozen benchmarks and own fewshots")
+    nearest = {}
+    for name, group in index["groups"].items():
+        if not group.get("snapshot"):
+            raise ValueError("Missing frozen source snapshot identifier")
+        nearest[name] = {}
+        for mode, threshold in [("text", text_threshold), ("image", image_threshold)]:
+            rows = group[mode]
+            if not rows:
+                raise ValueError("Empty text/image index; screening is incomplete")
+            scores = [(cosine(candidate[mode + "_vector"], x["vector"]), x["id"]) for x in rows]
+            similarity, ident = max(scores)
+            nearest[name][mode] = {"id": ident, "cosine": similarity, "threshold": threshold,
+                                    "contaminated": similarity >= threshold}
+    passed = not any(x["contaminated"] for group in nearest.values() for x in group.values())
+    return {"passed": passed, "nearest": nearest, "protocol": index["protocol"]}
+
+
+def run(jobpath, configpath):
+    job, cfg = read(jobpath), read(configpath)
+    if job["stage"] != "decontaminate":
+        raise ValueError("Wrong guard stage")
+    root = Path(job["output_dir"])
+    indexpath = (Path(configpath).resolve().parent / cfg["index"]).resolve()
+    vector_job = root / "embedding-job.json"
+    vector_result = root / "embedding-result.json"
+    payload = job["input"]
+    write(vector_job, {"schema_version": 1, "input": {
+        "text": payload["seed"]["text"] + "\n\n" + payload["package"]["requirements"]["task_prompt"],
+        "image": payload["reference"]}, "result_file": str(vector_result)})
+    with (root / "embedding.log").open("wb") as log:
+        subprocess.run([*cfg["vectorizer"], "--job", str(vector_job)], stdout=log, stderr=log,
+                       timeout=cfg["timeout_seconds"], check=True)
+    report = evaluate(read(indexpath), read(vector_result), cfg["text_cosine_threshold"], cfg["image_cosine_threshold"])
+    report["index_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(indexpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    write(root / "similarity-report.json", report)
+    write(job["result_file"], {"complete": True, "passed": report["passed"], "benchmarks": sorted(BENCHMARKS),
+          "method": "frozen text/image cosine nearest-neighbor guard", "evidence_files": ["similarity-report.json", "embedding-result.json"]})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("--job", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--config", required=True)
+    a = p.parse_args()
+    run(a.job, a.config)

+        elif isinstance(value, list):
+            for item in value:
+                if isinstance(item, dict):
+                    evidence_files(item, root)

+class Strict(BaseModel):

+
+
+class Model(Strict):
+    base_url: str = ""
+    model: str
+    api_key_env: str
+    api_key_file_env: str = ""
+    temperature: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0, le=2)

+    timeout_seconds: float = Field(default=300, gt=0)
+    routing_headers: list[str] = []
+    extra_body: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def no_override(self):
+        reserved = {"messages", "model", "tools", "stream", "temperature", "top_p", "max_tokens"}
+        if reserved & self.extra_body.keys():
+            raise ValueError("extra_body cannot override standard request fields")
+        if any("key" in k.lower() or "token" == k.lower() for k in self.extra_body):
+            raise ValueError("Credentials must use environment or private file, not extra_body")
+        return self
+
+    def key(self):
+        if self.api_key_file_env:
+            path = Path(os.environ[self.api_key_file_env]).expanduser().resolve()
+            if path.stat().st_mode & 0o077:
+                raise ValueError("Credential file must be private (chmod 600)")
+            return path.read_text().strip()
+        value = os.environ.get(self.api_key_env, "")
+        if not value:
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing environment variable {self.api_key_env}")
+        return value
+
+
+class Sampling(Strict):
+    max_rollouts: int = Field(default=6, ge=1, le=100)
+    qualifying_required: int = Field(default=2, ge=1)
+    dimension_floor: float = Field(default=0.5, ge=0, le=1)
+    mean_floor: float = Field(default=0.6, ge=0, le=1)
+    geometry_offsets: list[float] = [0, 0.006, 0.022, 0.052, 0.060]
+    clip_visual: bool = True
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def feasible(self):
+        if self.qualifying_required > self.max_rollouts:
+            raise ValueError("qualifying_required exceeds max_rollouts")
+        if len(self.geometry_offsets) != 5 or any(not 0 <= x <= 1 for x in self.geometry_offsets):

+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def encode(value):
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
+
+
+def hash_value(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(encode(value).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as f:
+        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            h.update(block)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def save(path, value):
+    path = Path(path)
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    with tmp.open("w") as f:
+        f.write(encode(value) + "\n")
+        f.flush()
+        os.fsync(f.fileno())
+    os.replace(tmp, path)
+
+
+def read(path):
+    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
+
+
+class Pending(RuntimeError):
+    """A request may have executed. Keep its marker and reconcile before resuming."""
+
+
+class Ledger:
+    def __init__(self, root):
+        self.root = Path(root).resolve()
+        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+

+        key = hash_value(payload)
+        directory = self.root / name
+        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+        result = directory / "result.json"
+        if request.exists():
+            if read(request)["fingerprint"] != key:

+            return receipt["value"]
+        if request.exists():
+            raise Pending(f"Unresolved operation {directory}; reconcile, do not delete/replay blindly")
+        save(request, {"fingerprint": key, "payload": payload, "status": "started"})
+        value = fn(directory)
+        files = {}
+        for p in directory.rglob("*"):
+            if p.is_file() and p.name not in {"request.json", "result.json"}:
+                files[str(p.resolve())] = sha(p)
+        save(result, {"fingerprint": key, "value": value, "files": files})
+        return value

+    directory = Path(directory).resolve()

+import base64
+from copy import deepcopy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import zlib
+from .storage import read, save

+
+PROTOCOL_TAG_RE = re.compile(
+    r"</?(?:invoke|parameter|function_calls|tool_call|tool_response|tool_result|antml\b)\b"
+    r"|<\s*\|\s*DSML\s*\|"
+    r"|｜\s*DSML\s*｜"
+    r"|<\|(?:im_end|endoftext|tool_calls?)\|>",
+    re.IGNORECASE,
+)
+THINK_TAG_RE = re.compile(r"</?think\b[^>]*>", re.IGNORECASE)
+PSEUDO_CALL_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:::|```(?:json)?\s*)?\{\s*"(?:command|file_path|tool_calls|function)"\s*:',
+    re.MULTILINE,
+)
+RUNTIME_EXCEPTION_RE = re.compile(
+    r"Traceback \(most recent call last\):|"
+    r"\b(?:SyntaxError|ReferenceError|TypeError|NameError|IndentationError|InputValidationError):|"
+    r"\[error\] tool reported failure|"
+    r"\bunknown tool\b",
+    re.IGNORECASE,
+)
+ACTION_INTENT_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:let me|i will|i'll|now let's|going to|let's|ok\.?|go\.?|now\.?|here\.?|wait\.?)\b",
+    re.IGNORECASE,
+)
+
+
+def _estimate_tokens(message):
+    text = json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False)
+    return max(1, len(text) // 4)
+
+
+def _extract_text(content):
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        return content
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        parts = []
+        for item in content:
+            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
+                parts.append(str(item.get("text", "")))
+        return "\n".join(parts)
+    return ""
+
+
+def _extract_thinking(content):
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        parts = []
+        for item in content:
+            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "thinking":
+                parts.append(str(item.get("thinking", "")))
+        return "\n".join(parts)
+    return ""
+
+
+def _extract_images(content):
+    images = []
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        for item in content:
+            if not isinstance(item, dict):
+                continue
+            if item.get("type") == "image_url":
+                obj = item.get("image_url")
+                url = obj.get("url", "") if isinstance(obj, dict) else str(obj or "")
+                if url.startswith("data:image/") and ";base64," in url:
+                    raw = base64.b64decode(url.split(",", 1)[1], validate=True)
+                    images.append(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
+            elif item.get("type") == "image":
+                src = item.get("source")
+                if isinstance(src, dict) and src.get("type") == "base64" and src.get("data"):
+                    raw = base64.b64decode(str(src["data"]), validate=True)
+                    images.append(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
+            elif item.get("type") == "tool_result" and isinstance(item.get("content"), list):
+                images.extend(_extract_images(item["content"]))
+    return images
+
+
+def _is_compaction_boundary(item):
+    if not isinstance(item, dict):
+        return False
+    return (
+        item.get("type") in {"compact_boundary", "compaction", "summary"}
+        or item.get("subtype") == "compact_boundary"
+        or item.get("compacted") is True
+    )
+
+
+def normalize_trajectory_messages(records):
+    """Normalize raw trajectory records (OpenAI messages or stream events) into chat messages."""
+    messages = []
+    for item in records:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            continue
+        if _is_compaction_boundary(item):
+            messages.append({"role": "system", "content": item.get("summary", "[compaction_boundary]"), "compaction_boundary": True})
+            continue
+        if "role" in item:
+            messages.append(deepcopy(item))
+            continue
+        if item.get("tool") and "observation" in item:
+            continue
+        msg = item.get("message")
+        if isinstance(msg, dict) and "role" in msg:
+            messages.append(deepcopy(msg))
+    return messages
+
+
+def segment_at_compaction(records, compact_window_tokens=393216):
+    """Segment a multi-turn trajectory at compaction boundaries or token window limits."""
+    messages = normalize_trajectory_messages(records)
+    if not messages:
+        return []
+    prefix = [m for m in messages[:2] if m.get("role") in {"system", "user"} and not m.get("compaction_boundary")]
+    segments = []
+    current = []
+    tokens = 0
+    for msg in messages:
+        if msg.get("compaction_boundary"):
+            if any(m.get("role") == "assistant" for m in current):
+                segments.append(current)
+            summary_msg = {"role": "user", "content": msg.get("content", "[compacted_context]"), "loss_mask": True}
+            current = [deepcopy(m) for m in prefix[:1]] + [summary_msg]
+            tokens = sum(_estimate_tokens(m) for m in current)
+            continue
+        est = _estimate_tokens(msg)
+        if (
+            msg.get("role") == "assistant"
+            and tokens + est > compact_window_tokens
+            and any(m.get("role") == "assistant" for m in current)
+        ):
+            segments.append(current)
+            current = [deepcopy(m) for m in prefix]
+            tokens = sum(_estimate_tokens(m) for m in current)
+        current.append(deepcopy(msg))
+        tokens += est
+    if current and any(m.get("role") == "assistant" for m in current):
+        segments.append(current)
+    return segments
+
+
+def _has_repetitive_loop(text):
+    if not text:
+        return False
+    raw_bytes = text.encode("utf-8")
+    if len(raw_bytes) >= 4000 and len(zlib.compress(raw_bytes)) / len(raw_bytes) < 0.10:
+        return True
+    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    counts = {}
+    for line in lines:
+        if len(line) >= 4:
+            counts[line] = counts.get(line, 0) + 1
+            if counts[line] >= 8 and counts[line] * len(line) >= 120:
+                return True
+    sentences = [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"[.!?\n]+", text) if s.strip()]
+    if len(sentences) >= 8:
+        for i in range(len(sentences) - 7):
+            window = sentences[i : i + 8]
+            if sum(1 for s in window if len(s) <= 40 and ACTION_INTENT_RE.match(s)) >= 6:
+                return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _tool_observation_failed(observation_content):
+    text = _extract_text(observation_content)
+    if not text:
+        return False
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        parsed = None
+    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
+        if parsed.get("is_error") is True:
+            return True
+        if isinstance(parsed.get("exit_code"), int) and parsed["exit_code"] != 0:
+            return True
+        stderr = str(parsed.get("stderr") or "")
+        stdout = str(parsed.get("stdout") or "")
+        if RUNTIME_EXCEPTION_RE.search(stderr) or RUNTIME_EXCEPTION_RE.search(stdout):
+            return True

+
+def apply_turn_loss_masks(messages, trained_call_ids=None):
+    """Apply paper loss-masking rules to a trajectory segment.
+
+    Non-assistant turns receive loss_mask=True. Assistant turns default to
+    loss_mask=False (trainable), except turns exhibiting tool execution errors,
+    protocol format leakage, repetitive reasoning loops, or abnormal truncation,
+    which receive loss_mask=True while preserving subsequent self-correction turns.
+    """
+    if trained_call_ids is None:
+        trained_call_ids = set()
+    result = deepcopy(messages)
+    for idx, msg in enumerate(result):
+        if "loss_mask" in msg and not isinstance(msg["loss_mask"], bool):
+            raise ValueError(f"messages[{idx}].loss_mask must be boolean")
+
+    tool_failures = set()
+    for msg in result:
+        if msg.get("role") == "tool" and msg.get("tool_call_id"):
+            if _tool_observation_failed(msg.get("content")):
+                tool_failures.add(msg["tool_call_id"])
+        elif isinstance(msg.get("content"), list):
+            for block in msg["content"]:
+                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_result" and block.get("tool_use_id"):
+                    if block.get("is_error") is True or _tool_observation_failed(block.get("content")):
+                        tool_failures.add(block["tool_use_id"])
+
+    image_hashes = []
+    for idx, msg in enumerate(result):
+        image_hashes.extend(_extract_images(msg.get("content")))
+        role = msg.get("role")
+        if role != "assistant":
+            msg["loss_mask"] = True
+            continue
+        upstream_masked = msg.get("loss_mask") is True
+        reasons = list(msg.get("_turn_mask_rules", []))
+        raw_content = msg.get("content")
+        content_text = _extract_text(raw_content)
+        thinking_blocks = _extract_thinking(raw_content)
+        reasoning_text = "\n".join(x for x in (str(msg.get("reasoning_content") or ""), thinking_blocks) if x)
+        combined_text = content_text + "\n" + reasoning_text
+        calls = list(msg.get("tool_calls") or [])
+        anthropic_uses = [b for b in raw_content if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "tool_use"] if isinstance(raw_content, list) else []
+        call_ids = [c.get("id") for c in calls if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id")] + [
+            u.get("id") for u in anthropic_uses if u.get("id")
+        ]
+        call_args_parts = [str(c.get("function", {}).get("arguments", "")) for c in calls if isinstance(c, dict)] + [
+            json.dumps(u.get("input", ""), ensure_ascii=False) for u in anthropic_uses
+        ]
+        call_args_text = "\n".join(call_args_parts)
+        has_calls = bool(calls or anthropic_uses)
+
+        if PROTOCOL_TAG_RE.search(combined_text) or PROTOCOL_TAG_RE.search(call_args_text) or THINK_TAG_RE.search(content_text):
+            reasons.append("protocol_leakage")
+        if not has_calls and PSEUDO_CALL_RE.search(combined_text):
+            reasons.append("protocol_leakage")
+        if _has_repetitive_loop(content_text) or _has_repetitive_loop(reasoning_text):
+            reasons.append("repetitive_reasoning_loop")
+        if any(cid in tool_failures for cid in call_ids):
+            reasons.append("tool_execution_error")
+        if any(cid in trained_call_ids for cid in call_ids):
+            reasons.append("duplicate_tool_target")
+        if msg.get("finish_reason") == "length" or msg.get("stop_reason") == "max_tokens" or (
+            not content_text.strip() and not reasoning_text.strip() and not has_calls
+        ):
+            reasons.append("abnormal_ending")
+
+        dedup_reasons = []
+        for r in reasons:
+            if r not in dedup_reasons:
+                dedup_reasons.append(r)
+        if dedup_reasons:
+            msg["_turn_mask_rules"] = dedup_reasons
+        msg["loss_mask"] = bool(upstream_masked or dedup_reasons)
+        if not msg["loss_mask"]:
+            for cid in call_ids:
+                trained_call_ids.add(cid)
+
+    trainable_turns = sum(1 for m in result if m.get("role") == "assistant" and m.get("loss_mask") is False)
+    masked_turns = sum(1 for m in result if m.get("role") == "assistant" and m.get("loss_mask") is True)
+    return {
+        "messages": result,
+        "quarantined": trainable_turns == 0,
+        "trainable_assistant_turns": trainable_turns,
+        "masked_assistant_turns": masked_turns,
+        "image_sha256": image_hashes,
+    }
+
+
+def export_sft_trajectory(trajectory_path, output_path=None, compact_window_tokens=393216, task_id=None, backend=None):
+    """Segment a trajectory at compaction boundaries, apply turn-level loss masks, and save SFT export."""
+    records = read(trajectory_path)
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        records = [records]
+    raw_segments = segment_at_compaction(records, compact_window_tokens=compact_window_tokens)
+    trained_call_ids = set()
+    segments = []
+    quarantined = 0
+    total_trainable = 0
+    total_masked = 0
+    all_images = []
+    for idx, seg in enumerate(raw_segments):
+        processed = apply_turn_loss_masks(seg, trained_call_ids=trained_call_ids)
+        entry = {
+            "segment_index": idx,
+            "task_id": task_id,
+            "backend": backend,
+            **processed,
+        }
+        segments.append(entry)
+        if processed["quarantined"]:
+            quarantined += 1
+        total_trainable += processed["trainable_assistant_turns"]
+        total_masked += processed["masked_assistant_turns"]
+        all_images.extend(processed["image_sha256"])
+    report = {
+        "task_id": task_id,
+        "backend": backend,
+        "compact_window_tokens": compact_window_tokens,
+        "segment_count": len(segments),
+        "trainable_segment_count": len(segments) - quarantined,
+        "quarantined_segment_count": quarantined,
+        "trainable_assistant_turns": total_trainable,
+        "masked_assistant_turns": total_masked,
+        "image_sha256": all_images,
+        "segments": segments,
+    }
+    if output_path is not None:
+        save(output_path, report)
+    return report

+    def tag(self, s):

+    def graph(self):
+        g = StateGraph(State)
+        for name, node in [("P01", self.tag), ("P02", self.image_plan), ("P03", self.reference), ("P04", self.requirements),
+                           ("P05", self.rubric), ("P07", self.audit), ("P06", self.difficulty), ("decontaminate", self.guard),
+                           ("P08", self.sample), ("P09", self.collect), ("P10", self.visual), ("P11", self.product), ("select", self.select)]:
+            g.add_node(name, node)
+        g.add_edge(START, "P01")
+        g.add_conditional_edges("P01", lambda s: "P02" if s["status"] == "tagged" else END, ["P02", END])
+        g.add_edge("P02", "P03")
+        g.add_conditional_edges("P03", lambda s: "P04" if s["status"] == "reference_ready" else "P03" if s["status"] == "retry_image" else END, ["P04", "P03", END])
+        g.add_edge("P04", "P05")
+        g.add_edge("P05", "P07")
+        g.add_conditional_edges("P07", lambda s: "P06" if s["status"] == "package_ready" else "P07" if s["status"] == "audit_again" else END, ["P06", "P07", END])
+        g.add_edge("P06", "decontaminate")
+        g.add_conditional_edges("decontaminate", lambda s: "P08" if s["status"] == "task_ready" and not self.synthesis_only else END, ["P08", END])
+        for a, b in [("P08", "P09"), ("P09", "P10"), ("P10", "P11"), ("P11", "select")]:

+        g.add_conditional_edges("select", lambda s: "P08" if s["status"] == "sample_again" else END, ["P08", END])
+        return g.compile()

+    def run(self):

+                     "message": "Inspect operation receipts; unknown side effects are never automatically retried."})
